rights.source: MIT, root LICENSE applies; preserve copyright and permission notice
rights.generated_rom: not admitted: exact linked SDK and GCC runtime components/notices unresolved

fallback: Commission separately authored original bounded homebrew with explicit MIT code/asset grant and deterministic source-built ROM; do not represent an in-house diagnostic extension as independent playable qualification.

assets.authored: Tiles generated by main.c; resources.res is comment-only; PSG calls synthesize effects
assets.external: SGDK default font, startup/runtime/libmd and compiler runtime bytes not yet admitted

header_policy: Advisory; preserve original bytes, do not patch. SRAM remains unsupported. Static absence of save calls does not establish runtime absence of SRAM access.

gates.rights: blocked: linked SDK/font/runtime provenance and generated-byte notices unresolved
gates.reproducible_build: unrun: image digest identified but compiler version/source and generated-byte rights unresolved; no packages/images installed
gates.runtime_sram: unrun: no admitted built ROM; current CPU-only core cannot execute VDP/controller scenario

scenario.planned: Start one-player from title, scripted paddle movement until one score or 600 frames; trace every bus access and reject any access to 0x200000..0x20ffff or SRAM control 0xa130f1
scenario.limitations: Requires admitted bytes and later VDP/input implementation; instruction-only records are not a full bus trace.

build_failure_policy: Future isolated build must clear its own output directory, invoke pinned toolchain without || true, require successful exit plus nonempty ROM, record exact compiler/link inputs/map/notices, and compare two clean-build SHA256 values. No upstream prebuilt ROM is consumed.

selected_replacement.rights: Require written MIT source/assets/generated-ROM grant and complete transitive notices before admission
selected_replacement.dependency_gate: No playable-specific implementation or qualification may depend on this route until a concrete authored source revision, reproducible ROM and bounded SRAM-free scenario are admitted
